displayName: Dino Valley and Sea Creatures models
body: @Seraphirax Hi Hallow, Okay, look, I don't create models with that anymore, and I stopped doing this work a while ago. I didn't do it to offend anyone, much less harm animals, etc. If you think what I do on my page is unfair, I understand. I'll explain why I do this. Look, I'm a fan of Dino Valley and other Chapmei lines. I only bring models to Sketchfab to try and give people a reminder of their childhoods, and I do it because I wanted to make a game just for myself with those models. I wasn't doing it to steal from anyone, and I don't even publish them on YouTube. I understand your complaint, and I respect it. Thank you. Sincerely, Dino Valley and Sea Creatures models

A guide to the church from the Suffolk Historic Churches Trust dates the paintings to 1390-1400. https://shct.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/HOXNE-SS-Peter-Paul-with-St-Edmund-StEdCathSer17.9.23.pdf (probably based on the dating by E.W.Tristram).

The elements in the paintings are discussed here https://reeddesign.co.uk/paintedchurch/hoxne-seven-deadly-sins.htm (Seven Deadly Sins) and https://reeddesign.co.uk/paintedchurch/hoxne-seven-works-of-mercy.htm (Seven Works of Mercy). The Seven Works of Mercy include Clothing the Naked -- top left in the third panel from the left.

Historic England's entry for the listed building says: "On the north nave wall are 4 C15 paintings showing St. Christopher, the Seven Deadly Sins, the Acts of Mercy and the Last Judgement. Mid C15 carved octagonal font; the tall cover is dated 1879." https://historicengland.org.uk/listing/the-list/list-entry/1032509?section=official-list-entry

Hello, hi, modeler here. No this isn't AI and it's really easy to check.

First of all the topology, AI topology is usually way more messy and uneven alongside being made on a pose, Sketchfab lets you see both wireframe and the bones which imply there is a t-pose and the model is symmetrical, if you don't believe it, you can literally check.

The face being off is an argument that makes no sense since I personally prefer to stylize models, this is just how I wanted to make the face, the one thing that I think looks off are the tears, but that is cause Substance Painter messed it up and I hadn't caught it when I made the model. If you doubt it's a texture made in Substance, then you can also see them here in Sketchfab.

AI models are really easy to catch, so assuming a model is AI by a face alone makes 0 sense unless the topology or textures show it.

2. Klatki 5^12 6^2 powstają najchętniej. Sklejają się ze sobą heksagonalnymi ścianami tworząc pręty. Pomiędzy prętami automatycznie powstają pustki ograniczone ścianami pięciokątnymi. To miejsca na mniejsze klatki mniejsze klatki, konkretnie typu 5^12. Gdy wzrost prętów jest szybki, nie wszystkie mniejsze klatki zdążają zamknąć w sobie cząsteczkę metanu.  
3. Żółty sześcian to komórka elementarna (jeden z wielu wyborów). Widać, że klatki 5^12 tworzą sieć sześcienną objętościowo centrowaną. Na środku  każdej komórki znajduje się jedna taka klatka, a po 1/8 w każdym z 8 naroży, co daje łącznie dwie klatki. 
4. Każdy z 3 prętów dostarcza 4 połówki klatek 5^12 6^2. Zatem dwie klatki 5^12 przypadają aż na 6 klatek 5^12 6^2.
